description: Connect approved Jira Cloud or self-hosted projects with account and API token credentials to search issues, read issue details, and summarize activity through read-only assistant tools.

assistant_guidance.summary: Use Jira tools to search, inspect, and summarize activity in approved Jira projects.
when_to_use: The user asks for current issue information from an approved Jira project.
The user asks to find issues by text or inspect one issue key.
The user asks for an engineering activity report over a time window.

topics.summary: Search issues within an approved project, then inspect a specific issue.
topics.details: Use the project scope selected by the Connection. Search results are bounded. Use jira_get_issue for a known issue key and jira_search_issues when the issue key is unknown.

topics.summary: Collect compact issue activity across approved projects in one Tool call.
topics.details: For a time-bounded activity report, call jira_activity_summary once with all relevant approved projects. The Plugin makes fixed read-only Jira REST API requests in Python, rechecks Connection scope, filters the exact time window, and returns bounded evidence. Treat partial errors and possibly_truncated as coverage limitations instead of issuing per-project retries.

endpoint.title: Jira endpoint
endpoint.description: Root HTTP(S) endpoint for Jira Cloud or a self-hosted Jira instance.

email.title: Account
email.description: Non-secret account identifier paired with the Jira API Token.

secret_value.title: API Token
secret_value.description: A write-only Jira API Token with read access.

projects.title: Allowed projects
projects.description: Explicit Jira project keys this connection may access.

tools.description: Read one Issue from an approved Jira project.
Search Issues by text within one approved Jira project.

Get compact Jira issue activity in one ISO-8601 time window across approved projects. Use this once for engineering reports instead of separate searches per project. The Plugin makes fixed read-only Jira REST API requests in Python and returns bounded projected fields only.
